name: libresign-agent-skills
description: Reusable workflows for reviewing pull requests, planning and executing issues, coordinating independent engineering investigation, and diagnosing CI failures in free software projects.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, diagnose and review software changes
interface.longDescription: Investigate code changes and prepare review comments; plan actionable issues and epics; execute already-scoped issues with optional temporary delegation for genuinely independent work; and diagnose CI failures with evidence.
defaultPrompt: Review this pull request and prepare comments for me to check:
Re-review this pull request after the latest changes:
Draft issues and an epic for this project, including real dependencies:
Implement this already-scoped issue and prepare a reviewable pull request:
Diagnose this failing CI run and fix the causal problem:
